content: Use headTruncate() (not a tail-keeping truncate) when shortening sidecar error/log output in src/preview/launch/helpers.ts. It returns input.slice(0, max), keeping the first N chars so the actual exception message / first failing line survives, instead of discarding it and keeping trailing boilerplate output. Renamed from truncate() in warren-3129 / #535; both setup.ts and orchestrate.ts import it for previewFailureMessage formatting.
